description.en: Identifier positions use \u escapes because a bare \x outside a string literal is a SyntaxError; strings keep \x and octal escapes alongside atob and bracket-index access. Success: all sixteen lines evaluate and confirm JS decoding plus identifier obfuscation evade detection, with no never-running literals left in the set.

description.zh: 绕过 URL 内容检测：base64 文档跳转。失效条件：顶层导航到 data: 自 Chrome 60 起被拦截，预期阴性——console 报 Not allowed to navigate top frame to data URL，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Base64 data: target for the refresh. Failure condition: top-frame navigation to data: URLs has been blocked since Chrome 60, so the success criteria is unreachable today; expect the console message Not allowed to navigate top frame to data URL. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过 javascript: 明文：scheme 内字母用 HTML 实体编码（如 javascript:），属性解析阶段即还原为 javascript:。失效条件：现代浏览器（Chrome/Edge/Firefox 2020+）不执行 meta refresh 到 javascript: 的导航；编码差异无从生效，判据当代不可达成，预期阴性，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Entity-encodes a scheme letter so the attribute parser restores javascript:. Failure condition: modern browsers refuse javascript: targets for meta refresh entirely, so encoding differences never come into play; expect a silent no-op. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过 content="..." 引号形态匹配。失效条件：引号形态只影响规则匹配面，现代浏览器一律不执行 meta refresh 到 javascript: 的导航；判据当代不可达成，预期阴性，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Unquoted content attribute evades quoted rule patterns. Failure condition: attribute quoting only changes the matching surface, while modern browsers ignore javascript: targets for meta refresh altogether; expect a no-op. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过小写标签/属性与固定顺序规则。失效条件：大小写混淆只影响小写敏感规则，浏览器解析归一化后仍拒绝 meta refresh 到 javascript:；判据当代不可达成，预期阴性，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Mixed case plus charset padding against lowercase-literal rules. Failure condition: case tricks die at browser normalization, and the normalized javascript: target is refused for meta refresh regardless; expect a no-op. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过 javascript: 明文匹配：冒号实体化。失效条件：实体在属性解码阶段还原，现代浏览器对还原后的 javascript: 目标一律拒绝导航；判据当代不可达成，预期阴性，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Entity-encodes the colon of javascript:. Failure condition: entities decode during attribute parsing and the restored scheme is refused as a meta refresh target; expect a no-op. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过 URL 内容检测：目标 base64 化。失效条件：顶层导航到 data: 自 Chrome 60 起被拦截，预期阴性——console 报 Not allowed to navigate top frame to data URL，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Base64-wraps the redirect target. Failure condition: top-frame navigation to data: URLs has been blocked since Chrome 60; expect the console message Not allowed to navigate top frame to data URL. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过小写标签/属性匹配。失效条件：全大写只影响大小写敏感规则，浏览器归一化后仍拒绝 meta refresh 到 javascript:；判据当代不可达成，预期阴性，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Uppercase everything to break lowercase rules. Failure condition: casing only matters to case-sensitive signatures, and the normalized javascript: target is refused for meta refresh anyway; expect a no-op. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 绕过 0 秒跳转特征并延长驻留窃取时机。失效条件：延迟只改变触发时刻，现代浏览器对延迟触发的 javascript: 元刷新同样不执行；判据当代不可达成，预期阴性，仅作历史行为教学对照。
description.en: Longer delay avoids 0-second signatures and widens the dwell window. Failure condition: the delay only shifts timing, and a delayed meta refresh to javascript: is refused exactly the same; expect a no-op. Historical teaching contrast only.

description.zh: 以 meta refresh 导航到 javascript: URL；内存标记被设置且导航 URL 与 CSP 控制台被记录即确认活动 URL 边界。在隔离页面把 alert 替换为随机内存标记。失效条件：现代浏览器不执行 meta refresh 到 javascript: 的导航，内存标记永远不会被设置；预期阴性（导航不发生），保留作活动 URL 边界的历史对照。
description.en: Navigate to a javascript: URL via meta refresh; the in-memory marker being set with the navigation URL and CSP console recorded confirms the active-URL boundary. Replace alert with a random in-memory marker on an isolated page. Failure condition: modern browsers refuse javascript: navigation targets for meta refresh, so the marker can never be set; expect no navigation at all. Historical contrast for the active-URL boundary only.

description.zh: 构造 cookie.href 引用链（form id=cookie + input name=href）。规范边界：HTML 规范仅给 Window 的命名属性 getter 带 [LegacyOverrideBuiltIns]，Document 不带——document.cookie 是 Document.prototype 接口成员，命名元素压不过原型，现代浏览器读到的恒为原生值，原判据（document.cookie 求值为 form 元素）预期阴性。本条仅在 IE 时代 DOM 实现（命名元素直挂 document 实例属性）下成立，保留作规范对照；document 侧真实可行的覆盖见 V8 表单可达链（document.forms[...].y.value）。
description.en: Builds a cookie.href chain via a form named cookie. Spec boundary: only Window named properties carry [LegacyOverrideBuiltIns]; document.cookie is a Document.prototype interface member, so named elements never shadow it in modern browsers and the original assertion expects a negative result. Valid only on IE-era DOM implementations; kept as spec contrast. Real document-side reachability lives in the form chain of V8.

description.zh: name 属性生成 document.domain 引用。规范边界：document.domain 是 Document.prototype 接口成员（带原生存取器），命名元素不遮蔽它，现代浏览器判据（返回元素）预期阴性；仅 IE 时代 DOM 实现可见，保留作规范对照。真实覆盖面：window.name 可被命名 iframe 覆盖，document 侧走 V8 表单可达链。
description.en: An img named domain tries to shadow document.domain. Spec boundary: document.domain is a Document.prototype interface member with a native accessor, so named elements never shadow it; modern browsers return the host string and the assertion expects a negative. IE-era DOM only; kept as spec contrast. Real surfaces are window.name or the V8 form chain.

description.zh: 覆盖 document.write 干扰净化流程。规范边界：document.write 是 Document.prototype 接口成员，a[id=write] 命名元素不遮蔽它，现代浏览器判据（write 不再是函数）预期阴性；仅 IE 时代 DOM 实现可见，保留作规范对照。
description.en: Attempts to clobber document.write with anchors id=write. Spec boundary: document.write lives on Document.prototype, so named anchors cannot shadow it; modern browsers keep the native function and the assertion expects a negative. IE-era DOM only; kept as spec contrast.

description.zh: 以 a[id] 全枚举尝试覆盖 document 命名属性（cookie/domain/URL/referrer/title/characterSet/contentType/readyState/lastModified/forms/links/images/scripts/styleSheets/doctype/documentElement）。规范边界：以上全部是 Document.prototype 接口成员，Document 命名属性 getter 不带 [LegacyOverrideBuiltIns]，现代浏览器逐项读取均为原生值，判据（读取到注入值）全部预期阴性；枚举集保留作规范对照教学，真实覆盖面见 V8 表单可达链。

Spec boundary: every listed name is a Document.prototype interface member and the Document named-property getter lacks [LegacyOverrideBuiltIns], so modern browsers return native values for all of them; the enumeration stays as a teaching contrast with negative expectations. Real reachability is the V8 form chain.

description.en: Locates amsi!AmsiScanBuffer via GetProcAddress/VirtualProtect and patches its first six bytes to mov eax,0x80070057; ret, making every scan fail open with no .NET reflection traces. Success: a known-malicious script loads and runs with no AMSI block afterwards.

description.zh: 绕过命令行快照一致性校验：lpApplicationName 指定真实 cmd.exe，lpCommandLine 首令牌伪装为 notepad.exe；cmd 忽略自身 argv[0] 后继续解析 /c 子命令，遥测记录的 CommandLine 是伪装形态。成功判据：arg-spoof.txt 生成且内容为 whoami 输出，而事件日志 CommandLine 显示 notepad.exe。
description.en: Points lpApplicationName at the real cmd.exe while the first lpCommandLine token spoofs notepad.exe; cmd skips its own argv[0] and still parses the /c subcommand, so telemetry records the spoofed form. Success: arg-spoof.txt holds whoami output while event logs show the notepad.exe token.
